entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Assertion fails in ClassifyImplicitConversionFromExpression #86230
  • How can an analyzer obtain the members selected for union pattern matching? #86227
  • IDE0054 changes behavior when the type has a C# 14 instance compound assignment operator #86226

  • [Known Build Error] Pool leak in TestSuppression_CompilerSyntaxParseError_SuppressWarningCaughtDuringParsingStage #86221
    18.14
  • Implicit Index: Length property can change class instance used as a receiver for indexer/Slice invocation #86219
    18.14

Closed

  • Read editorconfig for all Razor formatting options #86135
    18.13
  • Incorrect lifetime reported for `using` local #85694
    18.12
